results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm recipient opt-in/permission and validate destination number format (international) and message text before using CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND (prevent unintended/invalid sends).

[Optional (if auth/credit is uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Check account readiness using CLICKSEND_GET_ACCOUNT (avoid failed/blocked sends; if low credit, review top-up options via CLICKSEND_RECHARGE_PACKAGES_GET).
[Optional (if cost/segment count must be known pre-send)] [Prerequisite]: Estimate segments/price using CLICKSEND_SMS_PRICE_POST (avoid billing surprises).
[Required] [Step]: Send (optionally scheduled) using CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND with messages[] entries per recipient (dispatch SMS).

[Required] [Next Step]: Verify acceptance by checking queued_count vs blocked_count and per-message status in the CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND response; retain messages[*] identifiers for traceability (avoid false positives).
[Optional (if delivery proof/audit is required)] [Next Step]: Retrieve delivery outcomes using CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_RECEIPTS and/or CLICKSEND_GET_SMS_HISTORY (confirm final status).

[Fallback (if sends are blocked due to destination rules)] [Fallback]: Check destination enablement using CLICKSEND_USER_COUNTRIES_GET, resolve any gating requirements, then retry once with CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND (recover from coverage/registration blocks).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] Each messages[] item needs both to and body; non-international formatting can trigger validation errors or blocks.
[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] message_parts can be >1 for long or non-standard character content, increasing total_price vs a single-part assumption.
[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] The response may echo a normalized/modified messages[*].body; don’t use it as exact-text verification.

[CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND] A SUCCESS/200 envelope can still have blocked_count>0 and queued_count=0 with messages[*].status indicating failure (often credit-related); treat per-recipient status as the source of truth.
[CLICKSEND_GET_ACCOUNT] 401 UNAUTHORIZED can occur even when an integration appears connected; fix credentials/scopes before attempting paid sends.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickSend is a cloud-based SMS and email marketing platform that enables businesses to send and receive SMS messages, manage contacts, and track campaign performance.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clicksend. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clicksend") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clicksend tools.

CLICKSEND_CREATE_SMS_SEND.description: Tool to send one or more SMS messages via ClickSend. Use when you need to send SMS messages to recipients. Supports up to 1000 messages per API call and provides detailed status for each message.

to.description: Recipient phone number in international format with country code (e.g., '+61411111111'). Must include the '+' prefix and country code.

body.description: Message content/text to send. Standard message contains only GSM characters (max 160 chars). Unicode message contains characters outside GSM set (max 70 chars).

from.description: Sender identifier - can be a shared number, dedicated number, alpha tag (business name), or your own number. If not provided, uses default sender.

source.description: Message source identifier for tracking purposes (e.g., 'sdk', 'php', 'api').

country.description: Destination country code for automatic country code addition to phone numbers.

list_id.description: Contact list identifier to send messages to contacts from your list. If provided, sends to all contacts in the specified list.

schedule.description: Unix timestamp for scheduled sending. If provided, message will be sent at the specified time instead of immediately.

from_email.description: Sender email address if sending via email-to-SMS.

custom_string.description: Custom reference string for tracking purposes. Can be used to associate the message with your internal systems.

items.description: Data model for a single SMS message.

messages.description: List of SMS messages to send. You can post up to 1000 messages with each API call. Each message must have 'to' and 'body' fields at minimum. The `to` field must be in full international format with '+' and country code (e.g., '+12025551234'). Optional `schedule` field accepts a Unix timestamp (seconds) to delay sending; omit to send immediately. Long or Unicode-heavy `body` values may be split into multiple SMS segments, affecting billing.

CLICKSEND_GET_ACCOUNT.description: Tool to retrieve authenticated user's account information. Use when you need to view account details such as balance, user information, settings, and billing details.

CLICKSEND_RECHARGE_PACKAGES_GET.description: Tool to retrieve all available recharge packages from ClickSend. Use when you need to view pricing and quantity information for SMS, voice, fax, email, and postal mail services.

country.description: Country code to filter packages by specific country (e.g., 'US', 'AU', 'GB').
